title: Publish @videoml/player and swap Babulus preview controls to TransportControls
description: Cross-repo, tracks AnthusAI/videoml-player vmlp-hgy (done) and vmlp-04b (blocked). STATE 2026-10-19: TransportControls built in videoml-player PR #2 (draft, stacked on PR #1 Kanbus migration, both unmerged; main only has the license PR #3). Babulus studio-web still pins npm @videoml/player 1.0.0 (Feb 2026, no transport). BLOCKERS only Ryan can clear: (1) merge PR #1 then #2 into main; (2) set npm Trusted Publisher for @videoml/player (owner AnthusAI, repo videoml-player, workflow release.yml) or add NPM_TOKEN secret; (3) run the manual Release workflow. THEN: replace four hand-built control bars (PreviewPlayer, PreviewEmbed, DocsPreviewPlayer, video-editor) with TransportControls; Babulus previews render ScriptData, so reuse TransportControls, not VideomlPlayer. Ryan chose 'Fix npm publishing' on 2026-10-17; no further progress since. Not approved: vendoring the player into Babulus.
